title: Data enrichment Round 3: builder/designer enrichment + builder-graph cleanup (dedupe, suspect nodes)
description: Integrate research/round2/builder-enrichment.md and designer-directory.md into the graph. (1) Builder enrichment mapper: attrs (country, city, founded, specialty, status, parent_company, website) resolved onto EXISTING builder nodes by exact/normalized name — 75 covered builders. (2) Designer mapper: enrich the 10 existing designer nodes (exact names preserved in research) + create ~50 new ones with discipline/notable-yachts attrs; where Notable Yachts match existing yacht nodes, add designed_by edges. (3) Cleanup: merge ~15 duplicate builder pairs (CRN/CRN Yachts etc. — merge edges onto canonical node, preserving yacht built_by links), handle 13 suspect nodes (Y.CO→company, Hoek Design→designer, placeholders like Custom/Various get flagged attrs or removal per judgment with tests, '(Naval-inspired)' designer artifact re-pointed). Cleanup MUST respect the ingestion-order invariant and update the baseline-lock pins deliberately (documented in the commit). Depends on TASK-017 (mappers/knowledge numbering).
acceptance_criteria: Builder type attr coverage rises from 0% to >=40% overall and 100% for builders with >=3 yachts; score reflects it
Designer type grows to >=55 nodes with discipline + notable_yachts attrs; new designed_by edges created where yacht names resolve
Duplicate builder pairs merged with no lost built_by edges (edge counts reconciled in tests); suspect nodes reclassified or removed with per-node rationale in the commit/curation notes
Baseline-lock test updated intentionally (old pins documented in commit message), ingestion-order invariant otherwise intact
All ingest + app tests green, typecheck clean, graph re-exported + synced, completeness score delta recorded

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: CLOSED on green review (APPROVE). Score 6.02→6.67. Builder attrs 0→42.66% (independently recomputed), designers 10→60 (86 grounded designed_by edges), 18 merges (incl. Weichai with provenance) + 13 suspect nodes resolved, built_by 563→553 reconciled 1:1, 498+114 tests, pins updated with documented arithmetic. AC1 WAIVER (recorded per reviewer): the "100% for >=3-yacht builders" clause is met in spirit for Custom/Various (flagged placeholders, not companies) but NOT for builder:olympic-yacht-services — real Greek yard, empty attrs, no row existed in round-2 research. Waived as non-blocking; follow-up item assigned to Round 5 research (one enrichment row + ingest). Reviewer's reproducible tier metric is 35/38 (developer's 55/58 was a denominator discrepancy) — future rounds measure against 35/38 basis. LOW carry-forwards to TASK-020: mergeNode should stamp provenance:['graph-cleanup-merge'] on trace-less canonical nodes; attrs merge should union provenance arrays instead of first-non-empty-wins.
